verdict.rationale: ADK supports local dev/test workflows (adk run, adk web, adk eval, local Docker deploy) that are inherently separate from production Cloud Run/Agent Runtime deployments, implying a sandbox-like test environment, but there is no explicit documentation of a 'sandbox environment' isolated from production data or of test data isolation guarantees. missing for 10: explicit sandbox/staging environment documentation, guidance on isolating test data from production data, confirmation that local/dev runs never touch production data stores.
